notes.title: Assassin’s Creed, Far Cry and Rainbow Six will soon have their developments "spearheaded" by Ubisoft and Tencent's new €4 billion baby
notes.notes:
Well, there you go. After all the chatter about Ubisoft and Tencent possibly doing a business thing together, the mega-corps have gone and done one. It's a deal to create a new mini-Ubisoft subsidiary that'll "spearhead development" on the Assassin's Creed, Far Cry and Rainbow Six series.

Read more

notes.title: Tencent hand Ubisoft a big wad of cash to spin out Assassin's Creed, Far Cry, and Rainbow Six as a separate business
notes.notes:
Well, there you have it folks. After months of uncertainty over share price falls, major game delays and squabbles with investors, Ubisoft have opened up a new subsidiary to look after their biggest-selling Assassin's Creed, Rainbow Six, and Far Cry games, with Tencent chucking in a whopping €1.16 billion - meaning that the latter will have a 25% stake in the new spin-off business when all is said and done.

Read more

notes.title: Steam Achievements Are Here for Far Cry 6!
notes.notes:
¡Hola, Guerrillas!

Exciting news: Steam Achievements for Far Cry 6 are now live!

Whether you’ve been fighting for Yara’s freedom or just beginning your revolution, you can now display your achievements directly on Steam.
 
[h2]GOOD TO KNOW[/h2]

[h3]Do Achievements Sync Automatically?[/h3]
Launch the game once on Steam, and any achievements you’ve unlocked in Ubisoft Connect will sync automatically. No need to redo your hard-fought victories, they’ll unlock as soon as you play.

[h3]What About Far Cry 3 and 4?[/h3]
Achievements for Far Cry 3 and Far Cry 4 are in the works, and we’ll keep you posted. Stay tuned for more updates!

So call your Amigos, grab your Supremo, and let’s take the revolution to the next level. 

Viva Libertad!
